reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound: DNN potentials are known to capture complex many-body interactions better than EAM, and training on ab initio solid and liquid data should improve phase-space overlap, though the claimed 40-50% reduction and 5 meV/atom accuracy are optimistic without evidence.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and decisive: compute free-energy differences via TI with both potentials and compare to a direct ab initio benchmark; the falsification criteria (5 meV/atom deviation, 40-50% mismatch reduction) are specific and measurable.
reasons.usefulness: This is highly useful for researchers addressing the EAM limitation in TOR-TILD, as it proposes a concrete, modern alternative with a well-defined validation strategy and quantitative benchmarks.
